aboutPage.title: About GovGuide
aboutPage.subtitle: Empowering every Indian citizen with clear, accessible, and verified welfare scheme discovery.
aboutPage.missionDesc: Government of India and state governments administer hundreds of welfare schemes, but millions of eligible citizens miss out due to information fragmentation. GovGuide solves this by providing a unified, transparent, and deterministic discovery platform.
aboutPage.value1Desc: Every scheme indexes verified .gov.in portals. We never collect application fees or claim false authority.
aboutPage.value2Desc: Eligibility calculations are mathematical and rule-based, preventing hallucinations and misinformation.
aboutPage.value3Desc: Designed for accessibility, ease of use, and multi-language support across India.
